title: 基因编辑之思
text:
显微镜下的一段双螺旋结构被精准剪切，标志着生物技术进入了前所未有的微观操控时代。这种基于CRISPR-Cas9的基因编辑技术，赋予了人类直接修改生命蓝图的能力。从理论层面来看，该手段旨在消除遗传性疾病，提升生物体的生存质量。然而，当干预对象从体细胞延伸至生殖细胞时，伦理困境随之凸显。
基因组的永久性改变意味着相关变异将传递给后代，从而影响人类基因库的演化轨迹。这种不可逆的操作引发了关于生物多样性丧失的深刻忧虑。与此同时，社会公平问题成为了学术讨论的核心。若基因增强成为一种可购买的商品，社会阶层可能会在生物学层面被固化。
在这种假设下，优生学的幽灵重新出现，可能导致新形式的歧视与排斥。定义何为健康或完美，本身就是一个极具主观色彩的哲学命题。过度追求所谓的最优基因，或许会削弱人类面对未知挑战的适应能力。此外，技术滥用可能导致生态平衡遭到破坏，引发不可预见的连锁反应。
因此，建立一套全球统一的监管框架显得至关重要。法律应当在鼓励科研创新与维护生命尊严之间寻求平衡。透明的审查机制能够有效遏制违背伦理的秘密实验。科学研究不应脱离人文关怀而孤立存在。
我们需要审慎评估技术红利与潜在风险的比例。在追求医疗突破的同时，必须坚守对自然生命演进规律的敬畏。只有在伦理共识的指引下，基因编辑才能真正造福全人类。这种审慎态度是防止技术异化的唯一途径。

questions.prompt: According to the text, when does the ethical dilemma of gene editing become especially pronounced?
options: When intervention extends from somatic cells to germline (reproductive) cells
When intervention is limited strictly to somatic cells
When the technology is used only in animals
When the editing targets are entirely non-human organisms

questions.prompt: What social equity concern does the text raise about gene enhancement?
options: If it becomes a purchasable commodity, social class could become fixed at a biological level
It would make all humans genetically identical
It would eliminate all forms of social inequality
It has no relation to economic class at all

questions.prompt: According to the text, why is defining 'health' or 'perfection' in the context of gene editing problematic?
options: Because the definitions are highly subjective philosophical questions
Because there is already complete scientific consensus on the definitions
Because health and perfection are legally defined terms with no ambiguity
Because these concepts have never changed throughout human history

questions.prompt: What does the text suggest is necessary to prevent unethical secret experiments?
options: A transparent review mechanism
A complete ban on all genetic research
Increased secrecy to protect researchers
Removing all legal oversight of laboratories

questions.prompt: What does the text say permanent genome changes in germline cells mean for future generations?
options: The mutations will be passed to descendants, affecting the future evolution of the human gene pool
The changes will have no effect beyond the treated individual
The changes automatically reverse after one generation
Only somatic mutations can ever affect offspring

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
